description:
FILED s473t5e (#1501 round 6) as the bookkeeping row for `re/`'s eighteen
one-row files, so that the directory's cause table has no gap.  Each is the
`*summary*` or "PCL produced no TAP output" row of a file whose real cause is
recorded on its shortfall row:

  re/anyof.t              NS:DynaLoader / XS -- Storable
  re/begin-once.t         #1723 (the `/o` modifier)
  re/fold_grind_8.t       no locale support (harness stub answers 0)
  re/fold_grind_a.t       NS:DynaLoader / XS -- Encode, via fold_grind.pl
  re/fold_grind_aa.t      same
  re/fold_grind_d.t       same
  re/fold_grind_l.t       no locale support
  re/fold_grind_u.t       NS:DynaLoader / XS -- Encode
  re/pat.t                #1720
  re/pat_advanced.t       #1590 (97.9 % of SBCL's 1 GB heap)
  re/qr.t                 (this row -- read it when the file is next measured)
  re/reg_email.t          #1716 (the DATA handle's seek)
  re/reg_fold.t           NS:DynaLoader / XS -- Storable; NS:Internals::*
  re/reg_mesg.t           #1590 (the missing `display_rx` helper)
  re/reg_namedcapture.t   #1724 / #1664
  re/regexp_nonull.t      NS:DynaLoader / XS -- XS::APItest
  re/regexp_unicode_prop.t #1036
  re/subst_wamp.t         #1664 (via subst.t's `constant::_CAN_PCS`)

`re/qr.t` is the only one this round did not measure, and the note above is
wrong about why: it is DIFF 3/1 in `baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv`, not OK, and
its one row is a REAL assertion -- `/$qr/ with $'_ aliased to a match var`
(perl-tests spelling: the punctuation match variable aliased into a lexical and
then used inside an interpolated qr).  Measure it once and either give the row
its own cause or fold it into whichever match-variable task owns the shape.
subject: the round's residue: the re/ files whose blessed rows are ONE row each, and what each one is
